name: Wind, Vegetation Motion & Environmental Response
design_rules: canopy moves slower and heavier than understory
grass and small foliage respond fastest to gusts
stone and CIV-00 landmarks remain effectively rigid
North Woodland shelters rain and wind near ground
Ring Basin amplifies exposed wind and gusts
rain direction follows wind without becoming a horizontal particle effect
mist advection is slower than rain movement
environment response never uses glow or emissive feedback
